tip.0: Move with WASD and look with the mouse. Hold Shift to sprint.
tip.1: The colossus is grazing in the meadow ahead. Approach it — or strike first.
tip.2: Left-click for a three-hit slash combo. Hold right-click to charge a heavy slash and release as the blade flares.
tip.3: Watch its wind-up, then press Space to roll. Rolling through an attack avoids all damage.
tip.4: Aim the reticle at a glowing point on the monster and press E to fire your grappling hook.
tip.5: On its back: W/S to climb, left-click to stab, hold right-click for a finisher. Hold Shift to brace when it thrashes!
tip.6: Climb to the neck and press E to ride. Steer it into a rock spire to slam it down.

settings.title: Settings
guide.title: Field Guide
guide.tactic1: Grapple onto glowing anchor points and climb to the vital points for bonus damage.
guide.tactic2: Break the back vital to topple the monster for a long opening.
guide.tactic3: Ride it from the neck and steer into rock spires for a wall slam.
guide.tactic4: Bait its charge into a rock spire to make it crash and fall.
guide.tactic5: Charged slashes to the head deal the most damage on foot.

boot.tip1: Tip: dodge through an attack at the last moment to trigger a Flow Evade.
boot.tip2: Tip: hold heavy attack to charge. A full three-segment charge unleashes a True Slash.
boot.tip3: Tip: grapple onto the beast, climb to a glowing vital point and strike it for huge damage.
boot.tip4: Tip: hammer one body part to open a wound — wounded parts take 25% more damage.
boot.tip5: Tip: follow the Emberwisps when your quarry flees to its lair.
